description:
How I Actually Use Hermes Agent in Business Operations

In this video, I break down why Hermes works better as an operator inside systems you already built - not as the primary builder. I cover 15 practical use cases I use across outbound, CRM workflows, research, content systems, reporting, investing, and operations.

I also show how I combine Hermes with Claude, Codex, MCPs, APIs, Firecrawl, Clay, NotebookLM, and internal tools to create AI employees that actually handle recurring work.
